title: Refraction
definition: Refraction is the bending of light or wave propagation when it passes obliquely from one transparent medium into another due to a change in its phase velocity caused by differing optical densities.
importanceInUpsc: Tested extensively in UPSC CSE Prelims via everyday optical phenomena (twinkling of stars, mirages, advanced sunrise and delayed sunset) and applied Science & Tech frameworks.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Refraction.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
